INSERT INTO [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY]
(DEPENDENCY_ID, 
TASK_NAME,DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))+ (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(DEPENDENCY_ID),0) 
FROM [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY]), 
'TSK_STG_EDS_TRY_PYATRADES' TASK_NAME,
'TSK_EDS_TRY_PYATRADES' DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME
